comment: Windows-kept localization pairs: v1.2.0 Mac catalog pairs that Mac 1.3.0 pruned (unused there) while
Windows modules that are not redesigned yet still call them through core::localized or a module string table.
tools/build_localization_catalog.py adds them, with the five languages of the Mac catalog at "base", to the
generated core/localization_catalog.inc. Each row: English, Simplified Chinese (the lookup pair), Windows callers.
Drop a row (or a whole group) in the change that removes its last Windows caller; the generator names rows
